notes.title: IMPROVING ACHIEVEMENTS
notes.content:
Dear Friends,

As of recent achievements have not been registering on Steam for some players. This is an obvious frustration that we have attempted to remedy.

Moving forward achievements should be working for more players as we roll out the update across all platforms.

On top of this we've received some feedback requesting a windowed mode, so that has been added to the game as well.

We apologise for the inconvenience, and hope that with time these little issues will no longer impede your experience.

With kind regards,

Voyager, over and out...

notes.title: VOYAGER ◯∘ - Available now
notes.content:
Dear Friends,

The VOYAGER ◯∘ has now officially launched! 

Now is the time, make the most of the launch-week discount, let us know how you feel about the game, and explore the cosmos in relaxing bliss!

We hope you enjoy your time with Voyager, and wish you the best of luck on your own adventures, and thank everyone who gave feedback to help shape the game.

With kind regards,

Voyager, over and out...

notes.title: Launch Update ◯∘
notes.content:
Hello there,

Thank you all for the excellent feedback so far! 

One major point raised by many of you was that the game was a little bit on the short side... Your feedback has been heard! So we have added 2 more unique level packs for you to explore ◯∘

As we get close to transitioning to the full release, now is the perfect time for you to leave some constructive feedback so that we can get everything polished to perfection for launch.

We hope you enjoy the new levels, and on top of this we've added a few extra features:

◖ Black Hole + Supernova Levels.
◖ New Art Styles.
◖ Collectable postcards of your journeys.
◖ Unlockable narrative.
◖ Screenshot functionality so you can share your unique journeys.
◖ Unique star chart for every user.
◖ Some quality of life improvements.
◖ Voyager campaign end song.
◖ A little collectible secret for all you early birds.
AND...
◖ A MAC VERSION!!!

Thank you for all the lovely reviews and feedback, they really are incredibly important to shaping the game moving forward. 

We hope you enjoy the new journeys and narrative in this update

With kind regards,

Voyager, over and out...

P.S.

Get your wish-lists ready for the launch week discount!

notes.title: LOCAL CELESTIAL MULTIPLAYER ◯∘
notes.content:
Hello there friend!

We've made some pretty good headway with the game, and to further spread the good vibes have implemented a local couch coop competitive mode so you and your bestie can chill out together!!!

Grab your spare controller, get comfy, discover the planets first, and with some gorgeous new colours to go with the new mode we've expanded the possibilities of the journeys you can create!

Knock each-other about with the original chill tunes if you are feeling collaborative and simply want to create pretty gravitational paths, or turn it up a notch with some up beat tunes if you want to get a little bit competitive!

Come now & explore the infinite power of close friendship!

With kind regards,

Voyager, over and out... 

◯∘

notes.title: VOYAGER ◯∘ - Feedback being implemented
notes.content:
Dear Friends,

We have listened to the community feedback, and are implementing changes!

A lot of people noticed that there was little audio feedback in the last version of the game, and this would not do! We have added a few little details and improvements to help have the quality of the game be uniform across all aspects of the experience. 

Thank you to all the people who provided feedback, your opinion is invaluable to us ◯∘

Beware big things are coming down the pipe! Stay tuned for future updates! 

With kindest regards,

Voyager, over and out...

notes.title: We Have Liftoff!
notes.content:
Dear Voyagers,

Thank you for all your lovely support and feedback while the game is in Early Access.

We are now confident that the game is in good working condition to be played in its current iteration, and wish you all happy Voyaging for the new year! Development continues, the soundtrack will be releasing soon as well, and all is set to have a smooth launch!

More updates to come soon!

Have a happy new year!

With kind regards,

The Voyager team

notes.title: Quality of Life!
notes.content:
Some visual improvements have been made to increase immersion:
- Sun effects with increased dynamism added 
- Boosting animation improved
- Planet discovery animation improved
- UI elements updated
- Player distance icon added

Some Gameplay tweaks have been implemented to improve feel:
- Tweaking to boost mechanic to smoothen planet discovery added
- Radar ping while idle added
- Endless Mode reset added
- Boost perpendicular to planet added
- Cursor indicating direction of boost added
